Build a GenBank submission bundle for a set of samples (one export group)

Source: R/export.R
export_bundle.Rd

Build a GenBank submission bundle for a set of samples (one export group)

Usage

export_bundle(
  path = ".",
  ids = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  out_dir = file.path(path, "export"),
  label = NULL,
  markers = TRUE,
  report = TRUE,
  template = NULL,
  run_table2asn = FALSE,
  zip = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

Project directory.

ids

Sample IDs to export (default: all with a stitched sequence). If `group` is given, restricted to that group.

group

Export-group name to filter by and label the bundle.

out_dir

Output directory (default `<path>/export`).

label

Bundle label (default: `group` or "export").

markers, report

Also write per-marker fastas / an HTML report.

template

Optional path to a GenBank submission template (`.sbt`); copied into the bundle as `<label>.sbt` so table2asn picks it up.

run_table2asn

Run table2asn if on PATH.

zip

Also write `<out_dir>/<label>.zip`.

Value

(invisibly) the group output directory.
